highlights.title: Anthropic’s Amodei Rejects Open Model Ban, Calls for Testing
highlights.description: Silicon Valley leaders from Anthropic PBC’s Dario Amodei to Nvidia Corp.’s Jensen Huang warned against a US crackdown on open-weight artificial intelligence systems, deepening a debate about how Washington should respond to a surprise breakthrough from Chinese startup Moonshot.

highlights.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
highlights.description: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.

highlights.title: Lyft and Baidu enter London’s robotaxi battleground as testing begins
highlights.description: Baidu's Apollo Go autonomous vehicles will be available on Freenow, the mobility network that Lyft acquired in 2025.

highlights.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
highlights.description: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.

highlights.title: Nvidia Staff Detained by Taiwan in China Chip Smuggling Case
highlights.description: Taiwanese prosecutors detained an Nvidia Corp. employee as part of a probe into the alleged smuggling of AI chips into China, thrusting the US company into a high-profile case concerning the black market for its products.

highlights.title: An Extreme Solar Storm May Be Even More Devastating Than Previously Imagined
highlights.description: Scientists have long assumed that there’s an upper limit to the intensity of the solar winds that reach Earth. New research suggests there’s not—and the implications are alarming.

highlights.title: Uber Eats Promo Codes: $15 Off│July 2026
highlights.description: Hunger meets savings. Discover verified Uber Eats promo codes, new user offers, and Uber One discounts to slash your delivery fees and meal costs.

highlights.title: Forget what you read on Facebook: 94% of EV drivers won’t go back to gas
highlights.description: On today’s episode of Quick Charge, the audio is sketchy but the math is absolutely rock solid with 94% of current EV owners saying they’ll NEVER go back to driving an antiquated gas guzzler. CDK’s David Thomas walks us through the findings.

highlights.title: ChatGPT is now refusing requests to write in famous authors' styles
highlights.description: ChatGPT has been refusing to imitate the writing of famous authors, both living and dead.

highlights.title: Australia’s ‘World-First’ Data Center Rules Face First Hurdle
highlights.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese’s proposed “world-first” environmental and energy controls for Australia’s A$150 billion ($105 billion) data center pipeline will face their first test Tuesday, when federal, state and territory energy ministers meet to discuss guardrails for the booming sector.
